name: Barbell Hang High Pull
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart holding a barbell overhand outside your thighs, then hinge with a flat back until the bar hangs above your knees.
Drive explosively through your feet and extend your hips and knees straight to accelerate the bar upward.
Follow through with a strong shrug, pulling your elbows high and wide as the bar rises toward upper-chest height.
Guide the bar smoothly back to your thighs while absorbing its weight with soft knees.
tips: Keep the bar traveling close to your torso rather than swinging it outward.
Finish extending your legs and hips before bending your arms to pull.
